Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Here’s how to make Umma’s restaurant-quality Korean Fried Chicken. One of the best fusions to exist. Perfect for Friendsgiving  as long as it’s served warm and fresh. Full recipe from our cookbook, UMMA, pg. 200. Link in bio to purchase if you want to support! Sweet & Spicy Sauce recipe on pg. 201. Recipe in the comments since it’s maxed out here. INGREDIENTS: 3 pounds (1.4kg) chicken wings, cut at joints, wingtips discarded (we just use Costco Party Wings and use it as is) 2 1/2 cups milk  2 teaspoons black pepper, divided  1 teaspoon miwon matsogeum (MSG seasoning salt)  3 1/2 cups (462g) Korean frying mix, divided (Beksul by CJ Foods) 5 tablespoons (50g) curry powder, divided (Ottogi in Medium) 1 tablespoon Dasida beef stock powder  1 tablespoon garlic powder  1 tablespoon onion powder  1 1/2 cups cold water  2–3 qt vegetable oil for frying  INSTRUCTIONS summarized to fit: 1. Rinse and drain the chicken, then transfer it to a large bowl. Submerge in milk, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour.  2. Drain and thoroughly rinse the chicken until the water runs clear. Pierce each wing 3–5 times on each side around the bone, all the way through. Pat dry and transfer to a bowl.  3. Toss with 1 tsp pepper and seasoning salt. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.  4. Heat oil to 330°F. Whisk 1½ cups (198g) frying mix, 3 Tbsp curry powder, Dasida, garlic powder, and onion powder. Gradually whisk in cold water until just combined; small lumps are fine. Coat chicken in batter.  5. Mix remaining 2 cups (264g) frying mix, 2 Tbsp curry powder, and 1 tsp pepper. Working one wing at a time, let excess wet batter drip off, then coat in the dry mixture without pressing. Tap the wing against the bowl twice to “shock” it, creating its signature wave pattern. Lower each wing halfway into hot oil for 2-3 seconds, then release. Fry 6 wings per batch, undisturbed for 2 minutes, then turn occasionally until golden, crispy, and at least 165°F inside (5–7 minutes for wingettes, 7–10 for drumettes). 6. Transfer the wings to the prepared rack as they finish cooking. Return the oil to 330 degrees and repeat with the remaining wings in batches. Serve w sauce as dip. #koreanfriedchicken #friedchicken #chickenrecipes #friendsgiving #protein

Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Crispy Baked Chicken Thighs Get ready for the ultimate easy dinner. These bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs are seasoned to perfection and baked until the skin is beautifully shattered-crisp while the meat stays incredibly juicy and tender. Ingredients Chicken: 6 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs Oil: 1.5 tbsp olive oil (or melted butter) The Seasoning Blend: 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp dried oregano or thyme 1 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp cracked black pepper 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, for a tiny kick) Instructions Prep: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet or baking dish with aluminum foil for easy cleanup. Dry the Skin: Pat the chicken thighs completely dry with paper towels. This is the most important step for achieving maximum skin crispiness! Season: In a small bowl, mix all the spices together. Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken thighs, then rub the spice mixture generously all over them, making sure to get underneath the skin as well. Arrange: Place the chicken thighs on the prepared baking sheet, skin-side up, leaving a little space between each piece so they roast instead of steam. Bake: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the skin is deeply browned and crispy, and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) at the thickest part. Rest: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving to lock in all those delicious juices. Tip: If you want an extra-shattery, charred crust, pop them under the oven broiler for the last 2–3 minutes of cooking. Just keep a close eye on them so they don't burn! #BakedChicken #ChickenThighs #EasyDinner #CrispyChicken #SheetPanDinner

It cooks effortlessly in the slow cooker! INGREDIENTS: - 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, diced - 2 lbs baby potatoes, halved or quartered - 1 1/2 cups corn kernels (fresh, frozen, or drained canned) - 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup - 1/4 cup milk or chicken broth - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper - 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled - 2 tbsp chopped parsley INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Place the diced chicken and baby potatoes into the slow cooker. Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 2. Whisk the cream of chicken soup with the milk or broth, then pour it over the chicken and potatoes. 3. Sprinkle the corn kernels over the top. 4. Sprinkle the cheddar cheese and crispy bacon bits over everything. 5. Put the lid on and cook on low for 4-5 hours or on high for 2-3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender. 6. Shred the chicken with two forks, stir everything together, sprinkle with parsley, and serve hot straight from the slow cooker. Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 4 hours | Servings: 6 #SlowCookerMeals #CrockpotRecipes #CheesyChicken #OnePotMeal #ComfortFood

Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken 🍗🧄 Ingredients: • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup chicken broth • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes • Salt & pepper • 1 cup spinach • Sun-dried tomatoes, optional Instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Sear in olive oil until golden and cooked through. Remove from the pan. Add garlic, heavy cream, chicken broth, and Parmesan. Simmer until creamy, then add spinach and sun-dried tomatoes. Return the chicken to the pan and coat with the sauce. 🧀✨ 2. Honey Garlic Chicken 🍯🍗 Ingredients: • 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, boneless • 1/4 cup honey • 1/4 cup soy sauce • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 1 tbsp cornstarch • 1 tbsp water • 1 tbsp sesame oil • Green onions Instructions: Cook the chicken in sesame oil until browned and cooked through. Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, and rice vinegar, then pour over the chicken. Mix cornstarch with water and add it to the pan. Cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken. Finish with green onions. 🔥 3. One-Pan Beef & Potatoes 🥩🥔 Ingredients: • 1 lb sirloin steak, cubed • 1.5 lb baby potatoes, halved • 3 tbsp olive oil • 3 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tsp smoked paprika • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • Salt & pepper • 2 tbsp butter • Fresh parsley Instructions: Cook the potatoes in olive oil until golden and tender. Remove and set aside. Sear the beef over high heat until browned. Add garlic, butter, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Return the potatoes and toss everything together. Finish with fresh parsley. 🌿 4. Loaded Cheeseburger Casserole 🍔🧀 Ingredients: • 1 lb ground beef • 1 small onion, diced • 2 cups elbow pasta • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese • 1 cup milk • 1/2 cup ketchup • 1 tbsp mustard • 1 tsp garlic powder • Salt & pepper • Pickles • Bacon, optional Instructions: Cook the pasta and set aside. Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic powder. Stir in ketchup, mustard, milk, and cooked pasta. Add cheddar and mix until melted. Transfer to a baking dish if needed and top with more cheese, pickles, and bacon. Bake until hot and bubbly. 😋 5. Sheet Pan Lemon Garlic Salmon 🐟🍋 Ingredients: • 4 salmon fillets • 2 tbsp olive oil • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 lemon, sliced • 1 tsp dried oregano • Salt & pepper • 1 bunch asparagus Instructions: Place salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Add lemon slices and bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 12–15 minutes, until the salmon is cooked through. 🌿✨ 6. Chicken Fajita Bowl 🌮🍚 Ingredients: • 1 lb chicken breast, sliced • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 packet fajita seasoning • 1 bell pepper, sliced • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups cooked rice • 1 can black beans, drained • Avocado • Sour cream • Salsa • Cheese • Lime Instructions: Cook the chicken in olive oil with fajita seasoning until golden. Add the bell pepper and onion and cook until slightly tender. Build the bowls with rice, black beans, chicken, and vegetables. Top with avocado, sour cream, salsa, cheese, and fresh lime. 🥑🍋‍🟩 7. BBQ Pulled Pork Sliders 🐷🍔 Ingredients: • 2 lb pork shoulder • 1 cup BBQ sauce • 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar • 2 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tbsp smoked paprika • 1 tsp garlic powder • 12 slider buns • Coleslaw Instructions: Place the pork in a slow cooker. Mix BBQ sauce, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, smoked paprika, and garlic powder, then pour over the pork. Cook on LOW for about 8 hours until very tender. Shred the pork, mix with the sauce, and serve on slider buns with coleslaw. 🔥🤤 #dinnerrecipes #easyrecipes #familydinner #dinnerideas #comfortfood

Garlic Butter Chicken & Potatoes 🍗🥔 I could make this again and again, it was so good… Ingredients 650g chicken breast (or thighs) 1 tbsp oil 1 tsp salt 1 tsp pepper  1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp chilli flakes 1 tbsp lemon juice 800g potatoes  1 tbsp oil 1 tsp salt 1 tsp pepper  1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp oregano 1 tsp thyme 1 tbsp butter 5-6 cloves garlic Fresh parsley Recipe 1. Dice the chicken and add oil 2. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and chilli flakes 3. Add some lemon juice and mix well then leave to marinate 4. Peel the potatoes and dice them into medium-sized cubes 5. Add oil then season the potatoes with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, oregano and thyme 6. Place in the air fryer at 200°C (400F) for 20-25 mins 7. Heat up a pan and add oil 8. Add in the chicken and let cook for around 4-6 minutes 9. Move the chicken to one side, then add the butter followed by minced garlic 10. Once the chicken is fully cooked, add in the potatoes and mix in well 11. Garnish with freshly chopped parsley 12. Serve, top with more parsley 13. Enjoy! #garlicbutter #chickenandpotatoes #chicken #potatoes #dinnerideas
